I started writing a new short story on January 10th.

My story is a sci-fi thriller.
My story is about a group of scientists who discover a mysterious alien artifact.
My story involves the alien artifact holding the key to unlocking the secrets of the universe.
My story includes a sinister plot that threatens the fabric of reality.
I am hoping to explore deeper themes about the consequences of playing with forces beyond our control.
I have been trying to write about 1,000 words per week.
I have been experimenting with the Pomodoro Technique to stay focused and take breaks to recharge.
